# r2 script menus: m01_johto (generated by gen.py; edit gen.py, not this file)
# Each menu: a RAM script at the call site's x,y with that site's message; every row snapped.
# Battle-room menus are drawn in their facility's lobby (the battle rooms run map scripts on entry).
start saves/r2menus_postgame.sav
include ../continue.txt
# the save has never entered the Frontier: skip the Reception Gate's first-visit scene
ev setvar VAR_HAS_ENTERED_BATTLE_FRONTIER, 1; end

# elev7  (GoldenrodCity_DepartmentStoreElevator_hns:44)
warptoloose MAP_GOLDENROD_CITY_DEPARTMENT_STORE_ELEVATOR_HNS 2 3
waitnotask map_name_popup:Task_MapNamePopUpWindow 600
evstart lockall; multichoice 20, 0, MULTI_7FLOORS, FALSE; closemessage; releaseall; end
talk elev7_m 40 - Task_HandleMultichoiceInput
snap elev7_r1
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 1 DOWN
snap elev7_r2
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 2 DOWN
snap elev7_r3
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 3 DOWN
snap elev7_r4
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 4 DOWN
snap elev7_r5
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 5 DOWN
snap elev7_r6
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 6 DOWN
snap elev7_r7
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 7 DOWN
snap elev7_r8
tap B 0
waitctl 900
